sourceExecution: supportPosition uses coordinate median of mobile non-incapacitated tracked dismounts, falling back to all on-foot members only if none are mobile. A50% centre blend applies when the prior centre is within100m. It picks a real nearest soldier for traces, but the leader does not control centre/direction. Support target lies15m(default,min12) short of the infantry body along vehicle-to-centre bearing. Water and normalZ<0.55 refuse.

findOverwatchPosition tests5rear rings*9angles=45candidates, behind the infantry median relative to a live threat,>=10m from friendly infantry, dry/slope/native object clearance and2D friendly path corridor, then current target LOS from hypothetical2.5m height. It sorts travel/radius/offset score.

updateSupport queries friendly infantry250m around vehicle, chooses nearest supplied current/shared threat, caches success AND failure for15s or15m body motion/changed threat identity. It may fall back to two rear corners, uses10m immediate run-over zone and repeated straight-segment tests, commands hold or at3s intervals forceSpeed+driver doMove. Default pace12/catchup30kmh, near25m infantry cap8,12m arrival hold. holdVehicle writes forceSpeed0.
